basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old music enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, ZappaScoreSeeker has recently delved into the world of Reddit to explore his passion for musical scores and compositions. With a background in music theory from a local community college and a day job as a freelance graphic designer, he balances his time between work and his love for music. Single and living in a cozy apartment filled with vinyl records and sheet music, he typically browses Reddit in the evenings after work, often from 7 PM to midnight. He dislikes overly commercialized music and has a penchant for discovering rare musical pieces.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ZappaScoreSeeker possesses a solid foundation in music theory, having taken courses during his college years. His knowledge is further enriched by self-study and frequent discussions with fellow music aficionados. His expertise is particularly strong in the area of instrumental scores and classical compositions.
